heroes.name: Astra Valen
heroes.title: Starlight Tactician
heroes.synergyHint: Excels with Heavy Defenders, Aegis Sentinels, and balanced frontline-to-backline armies.
heroes.biography: Grand Paladin of the Celestial Order who commands gilded shieldwalls and calls down judgments of starlight upon advancing legions.

heroes.name: Kael Virel
heroes.title: Tempest Lancer
heroes.synergyHint: Pairs with Swift Cavalry, Pulse Skirmishers, and aggressive flank tactics to break backlines fast.
heroes.biography: Master of the Gale Pavilion's wind-halberd school. His banner sweeps across the field like an autumn squall, shattering enemy ranks before formations settle.

heroes.name: Lyra Solis
heroes.title: Sanctum Weaver
heroes.synergyHint: Amplifies Field Clerics and healing cards for sustained endurance against multi-wave bosses.
heroes.biography: High Cantor of the Radiant Sanctum whose luminous hymns mend shattered armor and shield her faithful through relentless dark sieges.

heroes.name: Seraphina Kuros
heroes.title: Arcane Marksman
heroes.synergyHint: Maximizes Arcane Archers, Solar Pyromancers, and Chrono Weavers with lethal ranged focus.
heroes.biography: Seer-Sniper of the Obsidian Spire who binds twilight constellations to enchanted arrows, raining prism fire upon distant warlords.

heroes.name: Orin Vance
heroes.title: Bastion Quartermaster
heroes.synergyHint: Accelerates Command Energy for high-tempo card cycling, Armor Breakers, and Astral Automatons.
heroes.biography: Master artificer of the Ironforge Frontier who drives brass-forged supply engines, flooding the frontline with relentless reinforcements and ironclad wards.
